{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
count_neg999 = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {count_neg999}')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
duplicate_patients = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_patients}')

# Check association between arm and severity
tab_arm_severity = pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['severity'])
print('Cross-tabulation of arm vs severity:')
print(tab_arm_severity)

# Check if severity is associated with response
tab_severity_response = pd.crosstab(data['severity'], data['responded'])
print('Cross-tabulation of severity vs response:')
print(tab_severity_response)

# Summary of data
data.info()"}
